apiLoad.method: Three consecutive read-only health-endpoint waves from inside the application container

isolatedTaskLoad.method: In-memory task store and deterministic mock provider inside the application container; no production database or infrastructure provider mutations

scopeStatement: Controlled lab performance qualification. API results represent read-only localhost traffic; task-engine results use an isolated deterministic provider and in-memory store.
limitations: This is not an internet-scale, multi-node, or independent production load test.
CPU and memory values are point-in-time container samples, not high-frequency peak telemetry.
A future release candidate still requires production-like authenticated inventory-query load, durable PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ task load using disposable provider targets, and longer soak testing.
Formal production qualification still requires approval of the immutable Release Candidate image and its supply-chain evidence.
